title: Business automation in Tajikistan — CRM system | shamCRM

facts.fact: shamCRM states that 120+ companies already work in shamCRM in Tajikistan.
shamCRM offers a 14-day demo for businesses in Tajikistan.
shamCRM states that there are partners in every major city in the country of Tajikistan.
facts.quote: There are partners in every major city in the country.

facts.fact: shamCRM's Tajikistan page links to pricing plans denominated in TJS (Tajikistani somoni).
shamCRM states that a missed call is turned into a task so that nobody forgets to call the client back.
facts.quote: A missed call becomes a task, so nobody forgets to call the client back.

facts.fact: shamCRM's Tajikistan page lists three partners: FIN GROUP in Khujand, SomonLeads in Dushanbe, and shamCRM Tajikistan in Dushanbe.
shamCRM offers a 14-day free demo for teams in Tajikistan, with no card required.
facts.quote: We will connect messengers and show the pipeline. No card required, 14 days free.

facts.fact: shamCRM states that the plan for Tajikistan can be paid in Tajik somoni or US dollars.
facts.quote: The plan can be paid in somoni or dollars.

facts.fact: shamCRM states that there is no separate Tajik edition; Tajikistan uses the same shamCRM product.
facts.quote: No. It is the same shamCRM. There is no Tajik edition.

facts.fact: shamCRM states that product support is offered in Russian.
facts.quote: Which language is support in? Russian.

facts.fact: shamCRM says its request-a-call form promises a callback within 5 minutes during business hours.
facts.quote: Leave your name and phone, and we will call back within 5 minutes during business hours.

facts.fact: shamCRM says its demo workspace opens immediately after sign-up.
facts.quote: Workspace opens immediately · 14 days free · no card

facts.fact: shamCRM names FIN GROUP in Khujand as a local implementation team for shamCRM in Tajikistan.
facts.quote: FIN GROUP in Khujand. In Dushanbe, SomonLeads and shamCRM Tajikistan.

facts.fact: shamCRM names SomonLeads and shamCRM Tajikistan as local implementation teams in Dushanbe.
facts.quote: In Dushanbe, SomonLeads and shamCRM Tajikistan. They are local implementation teams
